title: StarNet build and ship-size hook
owner_instruction: Nothing to set: preflight auto-detects the StarNet Workshop folder ({starnet_dir}, steamapps/workshop/content/281990/<id>); record what the check finds.
question: Is the ship-size hook string present in a 4.x StarNet build?

evidence.label: StarNet Workshop id
descriptor supported_version
files containing str_var_ai_ship_data_factor_

title: sae_bridge loads cleanly
owner_instruction: Run sae m0 stage M0-2, copy the mod and .mod file by hand, enable sae_bridge last, start a new game, unpause one month and quit.
question: Does sae_bridge load with zero error.log lines mentioning sae?

evidence.label: error.log lines mentioning sae after a fresh launch

title: log lines reach game.log
owner_instruction: New non-Ironman game, play 3 months, then save mid-month, reload, play 1 month; see sae m0 steps M0-3.
question: Do HELLO and HB lines reach game.log, parse, and arrive once per game month?

evidence.label: StarNet monthly behaviour still runs (yes/no/n/a)
game.log truncated on launch (yes/no)
first lines differ from previous launch (yes/no)
HELLO after save reload (yes/no)

title: log flush latency <= 5 s
owner_instruction: Play at normal speed for 10+ months with the tailer running, then pause within 2 game days after a month starts and time the HB.
question: Does the paused HB appear within 5 s and no poll batch 2+ game months?

evidence.label: seconds until the paused month's HB printed

title: variable printing and counters
owner_instruction: Play on until you meet an AI plus 12 months, then compare one SNAP fleet value with that empire's fleet power in the UI.
question: Does a SNAP line print numeric fleet power with sid >= 1 that matches the UI?

evidence.label: one empire's fleet power as shown in the UI
SNAP fleet matches the UI (yes/no)

title: console run of sae_in.ini is applied and acked
owner_instruction: Run uv run sae m0 --user-dir <user dir> stage M0-6 --sid N --m M --target <player sid from a PLYR line> with N, M from the SNAP and HB lines, copy sae_in.ini by hand, type run sae_in.ini in the console, play to the next month.
question: Is the staged sae_in.ini applied and acked (APPLIED/OK) for the staged sid and seq?

evidence.label: managed AI sid from a SNAP line
latest HB m value
none, minor or bad at the moment of run
sae_posture opinion modifier visible (yes/no)

title: ship-size knob efficacy (only if M0-1 passed)
owner_instruction: Only if M0-1 passed: set the corvette factor to 100 on one AI, run 10 game years, count its new ships by size.
question: Does the ship-size knob push the corvette share to 0.70 or more?

evidence.label: share of corvettes among new builds, 0..1

title: flag-gated budget knob efficacy (A/B)
owner_instruction: From the m0_8_base save run two 15-year games (B: econ=military via M0-6, A: observe) one after the other and read the same AI's fleet power.
question: Is the flagged AI's fleet power at least 1.3 times its unflagged twin's?

evidence.label: unflagged twin fleet power after 15 years
flagged AI fleet power after 15 years (pass: fleet_b/fleet_a >= 1.3)

title: SNAP emission cost
owner_instruction: Run 20 game years at speed 0.95 with emit period 1, mod on and off, and time days per minute.
question: Does the mod change days per minute by less than 5 percent?

evidence.label: days per minute, mod off
days per minute, mod on

title: keystroke injection
owner_instruction: Backlog (T2): record skip with note backlog.
question: Keystroke injection is backlog: record skip.

title: autosave parse <= 3 s and fields match the UI
owner_instruction: Set autosaves to monthly, play 1 month, pause, set SAE_GAME_SAVES_DIR; compare the printed fields with the UI and note the save folder name (A-46).
question: Does the autosave parse (exit 0, valid C4, wall <= 3 s) with fields matching the UI?

evidence.label: fleet power, systems, tech count, alloy income match the UI (yes/no)
a new game with the same empire name reuses the save folder (yes/no)
autosave size in MB

title: resource baseline
owner_instruction: On a late-game save time 12 game months mod off vs on and note game RAM, the Pages Input/sec counter and the process name.
question: Does the mod cost 1 percent or less of seconds per game year?

evidence.label: seconds per game month, mod off
seconds per game month, mod on
game RAM in MB
game process name in Task Manager

title: additive economic subplan
owner_instruction: Add a zz_ economic_plans subplan in a scratch mod copy, run 10 years in observe mode and compare with an unmodified twin.
question: Is the additive zz_ economic subplan active while StarNet's subplans are kept?

evidence.label: what changed in resource trends vs the twin

title: Ironman check
owner_instruction: Start an Ironman game with sae_bridge, play 2 months, quit; {ironman_save} is SAE_GAME_IRONMAN_SAVE if set, else the newest .sav in a campaign folder created after this step started.
question: Does the Ironman save parse and is it flagged ironman?

evidence.label: path of the Ironman save used
launcher allows the mod in Ironman (yes/no)
console blocked (yes/no)
meta entry contains ironman=yes (yes/no)
sae-parse --sections meta reports meta.ironman (true/false/null)

title: Starved machine (R-4)
owner_instruction: Run uv run python3 bench/balloon.py --leave-gb 1.2 by hand during a 2-year game with the daemon, then sae bench bus runs/<id> --gate R-4; never automatic.

title: Windows Job cap and pause (R-5)
owner_instruction: On Windows, point paths.save_dir at the pathological save, run the daemon, pause 60 s and unpause with RAM above and then below the floor; run sae bench bus runs/<id> --gate R-5 then sae m0 record R-5.
question: Does the daemon log a budget_breach and keep running on the pathological save under the Job cap?

evidence.label: worker exit under the 1 GiB Job cap
I/O priority in Process Explorer

title: Low-end laptop (R-6)
owner_instruction: On the 4-core / 8 GB laptop run condition (c) for 2 game years, then sae bench bus runs/<id> --gate R-6.
